formats.wav: all 703 .wav (Ambient 245, Wavs 455, Music 3) are PCM 16-bit, valid headers (mostly mono 22050 Hz; 9 files 44100 Hz; 3 stereo): browser-playable, no conversion
formats.mp3: Music/Voice are MP3 (music 44100 Hz stereo 160 kb/s): browser-playable

rules.order: general list is played sequentially in music.txt order (index starts at -1, +1 per finished track, wraps); NOT shuffled (eZeus shuffles; the exe does not)
rules.combat_trigger: enemy units alive > 0, or enemy warships > 0, or two other condition functions (FUN_004E5E50(2,1), FUN_0052EEB0; unidentified, probably active invasion/monster event) -> state 1
rules.combat_pick: alternate long / short: first short (toggle starts 0 -> 1 = short), then long, then short...; random track inside the chosen list; when the track ends the next combat track starts
rules.after_combat: when the 10 min combat window ends or the threat is gone, the interrupted city track resumes at its saved position (state 3 -> resume)
rules.special_events: one-shot stingers (state 2) that pause the city track and resume it after: mon1 = monster/ hero-of-event arrival messages (arg 0,1,4), mon2 = monster slain / events (2,5), dis = disaster messages (3,6), games = games/ victory-type message (7); see docs/play/audio.md
rules.volume: music on/off DAT_00f2a76c; no per-track fade logic found in the exe (eZeus fades 1 s on switch)

layer1.rules: 1 draw per rendered frame: rand % 2000 == 1 -> if no layer-1 sound is currently playing, pick one entry uniformly (rand % count) and play it positioned in 3D around the listener for secs_min..secs_max seconds (rand), volume = ambient slider; only in normal city view

2.name: FARMING (also receives ORCHARD, FARMLAND and the terrain list named FARMLAND)

3.name: ORCHARD (unused slot; the file name ORCHARD never matches, its sounds go to FARMING)

layer2.rules: 1 draw per rendered frame: rand % 300 == 1 -> sample 3 random screen points (x in 0..W-10, y in 30..H), classify each tile as building / walker / terrain, draw rand(weight) for each, play from the highest; see docs/play/audio.md

events.note: index = FUN_005A4C00 argument; played at the sfx volume slider, centre pan; unset indexes are silent

button.when: every left mouse press that mouse_poll accepts (any button/UI click)

collapse.when: collapse_debris_spawn with the sound flag (building collapse)

place_building.when: a placed building/tile is committed by the build routine (flag param_6)

fire.when: a building ignites (fire spread) and when a fire figure spawns

recreation_panel.when: info panel kind 0xC is drawn (beautification building panel)

demolish.when: clear_land_commit calls idx 9 but no sample is registered: silent

message_arrive.when: new message (FUN_00521A70 calls idx 0x10) but no sample is registered: silent

combat.note: fight sounds per figure sound group (table 0x010E0518, filled by FUN_005A5D00; slot 1/2 attack, 7 hit, 8 die), played by FUN_005A6FE0 only when the figure is on screen, sfx volume; see docs/logic/services.md 6.1

rules.attack: FUN_004DB3D0: the figure that walked into the fight, at its start; criminals also every time their fight animation (8 frames, 1 per tick) reaches frame 1, and a vandal at work likewise
rules.hit: FUN_004DB7A0: on the figure hit by a non-lethal blow (every 24 fight ticks; criminals hit for 0 damage but still make the watchman play its hit sound)
rules.die: FUN_004DAB30: on the figure killed (start of its 128-tick dying)
rules.monster: figure_monster_update 0x004C8760: atk1/atk2 (FUN_004DB3D0(f, 0) -> FUN_004DC2E0) every tick it stands blocked (direction 11, bashing; 0x004C8C72) unless dying, and in melee (action 5) when its fight animation is at frame 1 (0x004C8D22); after a smash (end of action 27, 0x00532791); the Kraken plays slot 9 "appear" when spawned (0x0052F726); sound_play_sample refuses a playing sample
